mapper.insert: insert into sys_user (username, name, password, email, mobile, status, gmt_create, gmt_modified) values (#{username}, #{name}, #{password}, #{email}, #{mobile}, #{status}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update sys_user set status = #{status}, gmt_modified = now() where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from sys_user where user_id in #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_role (role_name, role_sign, remark, gmt_create, gmt_modified) values (#{roleName}, #{roleSign}, #{remark}, now(), now())
mapper.delete: delete from sys_role where role_id in #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_menu (parent_id, name, url, perms, type, icon, order_num, gmt_create, gmt_modified) values (#{parentId}, #{name}, #{url}, #{perms}, #{type}, #{icon}, #{orderNum}, now(), now())
